goal.insight: Present a unified visual narrative showing internet penetration gaps across all four dimensions (income, age, urban-rural, region) so the viewer can compare the magnitude of each divide at a glance
Highlight the steep gradient in internet penetration from the lowest to highest income quintile, making the spread between Q1 and Q5 visually prominent
Emphasize the contrast in penetration rates between Sub-Saharan Africa / South Asia and Europe / North America across all sub-dimensions
Show the urban-rural gap within each region, drawing attention to where this gap is largest versus where it is narrowest
Compare internet penetration between the youngest (15-24) and oldest (65+) age groups across regions, making the age divide visually clear
